dict_mnemonic.text: gratitude 是名词「感激」，形容词是 grateful；express gratitude 是表达感激，a debt of gratitude 是恩情；反义词是 ingratitude（忘恩负义）。

root: 来自中世纪拉丁语 gratitudo，词根 gratus 意为感激的、令人愉快的，核心义为「心怀感谢的状态」。

sensesIntro.en: Gratitude means the feeling of thanks, a lasting thankful attitude, or a debt of thanks.
sensesIntro.cn: gratitude 指感激之情、持续的感恩态度，或欠下的人情。

core.en: Thanks that settles into the heart.
core.cn: 落进心里的谢意。

branches.en: A gift is received with both hands.
branches.cn: 双手接过一份礼物。

branches.en: A habit of thanks grows over years.
branches.cn: 感恩在岁月里长成习惯。

branches.en: An old favor is still counted.
branches.cn: 旧日的恩情仍被记着。

branches.en: A feeling becomes a way of life.
branches.cn: 一时的情感，变成一种生活。

branches.en: Memory keeps the debt alive.
branches.cn: 记忆让这份情一直活着。

intro.en: Gratitude forms adjectives, adverbs, and its opposite.
intro.cn: gratitude 构成形容词、副词和反义词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is gratus, thankful.
latinIntro.cn: 其拉丁词根是 gratus，意为感激的。

items.example: I am grateful for your help.

items.exampleCN: 忘恩负义比拒绝更伤人。

definition_zh: 重复；反复；重复的事物；背诵
definition_en: the act of saying or doing something again, or a thing that is repeated
core_image: 同一段旋律在唱片上绕了一圈又一圈，针尖回到同一个凹槽
scene: 练琴的孩子把同一小节弹了整整一下午，这种重复让手指记住了旋律。 Repetition slowly turned the difficult bar into a habit.
sceneCN: 这里 repetition 是「重复」（第 1 个义项：同一动作或内容反复出现）；句意：重复慢慢让那个难弹的小节变成了习惯。

senses.title: The act of repeating
senses.definition: the act of saying or doing the same thing more than once
senses.definitionCN: 把同一件事说或做不止一次的动作
senses.example: Learning a language needs repetition.
senses.exampleCN: 学习语言需要重复。
senses.why: The Latin noun repetitio names the action of going over something again, so the act is the core sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁名词 repetitio 指把某事再过一遍的动作，所以「动作本身」是核心义项。

senses.title: Something that is repeated
senses.definition: a part, pattern, or event that appears again in the same form
senses.definitionCN: 以相同形式再次出现的部分、图案或事件
senses.example: The design is a repetition of small triangles.
senses.exampleCN: 这个图案是由小三角形重复构成的。
senses.why: From the act, the word easily shifts to the thing produced by the act.
senses.whyCN: 从动作出发，这个词很容易转到动作产生的结果上。

senses.title: Recitation from memory
senses.definition: the act of saying aloud something that has been learned by heart
senses.definitionCN: 把背下来的内容大声说出来的行为
senses.example: The teacher asked for a repetition of the poem.
senses.exampleCN: 老师要求背诵这首诗。
senses.why: Saying learned words over again is a special case of repeating, and older usage keeps this sense alive.
senses.whyCN: 把学过的词句再说一遍是重复的特殊情形，较老的用法保留了这个义项。

intro.en: Repetition comes from Latin repetitio, the noun formed from repetere, to seek again.
intro.cn: repetition 来自拉丁名词 repetitio，由 repetere（再次寻求）构成。

items.en: Repetere means to go back for something or say it over again.
items.cn: repetere 意为回去取某物，或把话再说一遍。

items.en: Repetitio names the act of going over the same ground.
items.cn: repetitio 指把同一内容再走一遍的动作。

items.en: Old French repetition keeps the noun sense of a repeated act.
items.cn: 古法语 repetition 保留了「重复动作」的名词义。

items.en: Middle English repetition is used for words, music, and patterns.
items.cn: 中古英语 repetition 用于言语、音乐和图案。

items.en: Writers use repetition as a rhetorical term for words deliberately said again.
items.cn: 早期现代英语中，repetition 成为修辞术语，指有意重复的词句。

items.en: Modern English adds the neutral sense of any repeated part or event.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了中性用法，指任何重复的部分或事件。

note.en: Repetition is the noun at the centre of the repeat family, and it is close to words for copying and recurrence.
note.cn: repetition 是 repeat 词族中心的名词，与表示复制和循环的词接近。

entries.definition: having many repeated parts
repeating things in a boring way
to say or do again
the fact of something happening again
the process of repeating a step or instruction
the act of making an exact copy
a practice performance done before the real one

normalIntro.en: Repetition shares the stem repet- with repeat, and the long noun ending makes the word sound like a process.
normalIntro.cn: repetition 与 repeat 共享词干 repet-，较长的名词词尾让这个词听起来像一个过程。

normal.en: Find repeat inside repetition, then add the noun ending -ition.
normal.cn: 先在 repetition 里找到 repeat，再加上名词词尾 -ition。

normal.en: The extra syllables mirror the extra rounds of practice.
normal.cn: 多出来的音节，正对应多出来的几轮练习。

normal.en: Rote repetition is the phrase for learning by sheer mechanical copying.
normal.cn: rote repetition 指纯粹机械模仿式的重复学习。

normal.en: Avoid repetition is advice about writing, not about practice.
normal.cn: avoid repetition 是写作建议，不是练习建议。

normal.en: Compare repetitive: the adjective describes a thing full of repetition.
normal.cn: 对比 repetitive：形容词描述「充满重复的东西」。

abstract.en: Picture a record needle returning to the same groove.
abstract.cn: 想象唱针一次次回到同一条凹槽。

abstract.en: Imagine a pianist practising one bar until the fingers move alone.
abstract.cn: 想象钢琴手反复练一个小节，直到手指自己会动。

abstract.en: Think of a wave pattern printed again and again on wallpaper.
abstract.cn: 想象墙纸上不断印出的同一种波纹。

examples.en: Repetition is the fastest way to make a phrase automatic.
examples.cn: 重复是让一个短语变成本能的最快方式。

examples.en: The essay suffers from repetition of the same idea.
examples.cn: 这篇文章因为反复讲同一个观点而显得拖沓。

examples.en: The pattern is a repetition of three simple shapes.
examples.cn: 这个图案是三个简单形状的重复。

dict_mnemonic.text: repeat（重复）换名词词尾 -ition，变成「重复这件事」；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: 拉丁语 repetere（再次寻求）的名词形式 repetitio → 古法语 repetition → 中古英语 repetition，指重复的动作或重复出现的事物。

sensesIntro.en: The act of going over something again comes first, then the repeated thing itself, and finally the special case of reciting learned words.
sensesIntro.cn: 先有「把某事再过一遍」的动作，再有被重复出来的东西，最后是背诵已学词句这一特殊情形。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a melody circling back to the same groove.
core.cn: 核心意象：旋律一圈圈绕回同一条凹槽。

branches.en: The act of saying or doing again is the centre of the noun.
branches.cn: 再说或再做的动作，是这个名词的中心。

branches.en: The result of that act becomes a repeated part or pattern.
branches.cn: 动作的结果成为重复的部分或图案。

branches.en: Reciting learned words is a special, schooled form of repetition.
branches.cn: 背诵已学词句是重复的一种特殊而受训练的形式。

branches.en: Act and product are two sides of the same recurrence.
branches.cn: 动作与产物是同一次循环的两面。

branches.en: Practice and recitation both rely on going over the same material.
branches.cn: 练习与背诵都依靠把同一材料再过一遍。

intro.en: Repetition is a Latin noun built on the repeat stem with the noun ending -ition.
intro.cn: repetition 是在 repeat 词干上加法语-拉丁名词词尾 -ition 构成的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb repetere means to seek again, and repetitio turns that action into a noun.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁动词 repetere 意为「再次寻求」，repetitio 把这个动作变成名词。

items.example: Re- opens the stem of repetition.
items.exampleCN: re- 出现在 repetition 的词干开头。

items.example: Petere is shared by repeat and repetition.
items.exampleCN: petere 为 repeat 与 repetition 共享。

items.example: Repetere is the verb behind the noun.
items.exampleCN: repetere 是这个名词背后的动词。
repetitio 在英语中变成 repetition。

items.example: Repetition keeps the full Latin noun shape.
items.exampleCN: repetition 保留了完整的拉丁名词形态。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词词尾

items.example: Repetitive adds -ive to the same stem.
Repetitious adds -ious to the same stem.

definition_zh: 扩大；放大；详述
definition_en: to make something bigger, or to speak or write about something in more detail
core_image: 一张小照片被放进放大机，墙上慢慢出现一个更大的影像
scene: 底片洗出来后，她把那张合影放大，挂在客厅的墙上。 They enlarged the photo and hung it above the sofa.
sceneCN: 这里 enlarge 是「放大」（第 1 个义项：使尺寸变大）；句意：他们把照片放大后挂在了沙发上方。

senses.title: To make bigger
senses.definition: to make something larger in size or amount
senses.definitionCN: 使某物在尺寸或数量上变大
senses.example: They enlarged the kitchen by knocking down a wall.
senses.exampleCN: 他们拆掉一堵墙，把厨房扩大了。
senses.why: The word is en- plus large, so the literal sense is to put something into a large state.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是 en- 加 large，字面义就是使某物进入「大」的状态。

senses.title: To become bigger
senses.definition: to grow larger without an outside agent
senses.definitionCN: 在没有外部施动者的情况下变大
senses.example: The shadow enlarged as the sun went down.
senses.exampleCN: 太阳落下时，影子变大了。
senses.why: The same size change is seen from the thing's own side, so the verb becomes intransitive.
senses.whyCN: 同样的尺寸变化从事物自身角度看，动词就变成不及物用法。

senses.title: To explain in more detail
senses.definition: to speak or write more about a subject, especially in the phrase enlarge on
senses.definitionCN: 就某主题说得或写得更多，尤用于短语 enlarge on
senses.example: She enlarged on the reasons for the delay.
senses.exampleCN: 她详细说明了延误的原因。
senses.why: Making an idea bigger by adding detail is a metaphorical extension of making an object bigger.
senses.whyCN: 通过补充细节把想法「变大」，是「把物件变大」的隐喻延伸。

intro.en: Enlarge comes through Old French enlargier from en- plus large, with large going back to Latin largus, abundant.
intro.cn: enlarge 经古法语 enlargier 来自 en- 加 large，而 large 上溯到拉丁语 largus（丰富的、宽大的）。

items.en: Largus means abundant, generous, or wide.
items.cn: largus 意为丰富的、慷慨的或宽大的。

items.en: Large means wide or generous, and enlargier means to make wider.
items.cn: large 意为宽大的或慷慨的，enlargier 意为使变宽。

items.en: The verb passes into English legal language for extending rights or property.
items.cn: 这个动词进入英语法律语言，指扩展权利或地产。

items.en: Middle English enlarge means to increase size, scope, or freedom.
items.cn: 中古英语 enlarge 指增加尺寸、范围或自由。

items.en: Enlarge on develops the sense of adding detail to a subject.
items.cn: enlarge on 发展出「对主题补充细节」的义项。

items.en: Modern English uses it for images, text, rooms, and explanations.
items.cn: 现代英语用它表示放大图像、文字、房间和详细解释。

note.en: Enlarge is the size word of the large family, and it sits near verbs for expanding and magnifying.
note.cn: enlarge 是 large 词族中表示尺寸的词，与扩大和放大类动词相邻。

entries.definition: big in size or amount
mostly, to a great extent
the act of making something bigger
to become or make larger in size or scope
to make something appear larger
to make something stronger or fuller
to make something wider or more general

normalIntro.en: Enlarge is en- plus large, and en- means make, so the word literally says make large.
normalIntro.cn: enlarge 是 en- 加 large，en- 表示「使」，所以这个词字面上就是「使变大」。

normal.en: En- means make, and large means big: make big.
normal.cn: en- 表示使，large 表示大：使变大。

normal.en: Enlarge a photo is the everyday use of the word.
normal.cn: enlarge a photo 是这个词的日常用法。

normal.en: Enlarge on a point means make the explanation bigger with detail.
normal.cn: enlarge on a point 意为用细节把解释「变大」。

normal.en: Compare large and enlarge: the adjective describes, the verb changes.
normal.cn: 对比 large 与 enlarge：形容词描述，动词改变。

normal.en: The ending -ment makes enlargement, the act or result.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ment 构成 enlargement，表示动作或结果。

abstract.en: Picture a photo slowly growing on the wall under an enlarger.
abstract.cn: 想象照片在放大机下慢慢爬满墙面。

abstract.en: Imagine a room opening up when a wall comes down.
abstract.cn: 想象拆掉一堵墙后房间豁然开阔。

abstract.en: Think of a speaker adding one more example to make a point clearer.
abstract.cn: 想象演讲者再补一个例子，把观点说得更清楚。

examples.en: Could you enlarge this picture for the exhibition?
examples.cn: 你能把这张照片放大用于展览吗？

examples.en: The company plans to enlarge its factory next year.
examples.cn: 公司计划明年扩建工厂。

examples.en: He enlarged on the plan at the end of the meeting.
examples.cn: 会议结束时他详细阐述了这项计划。

dict_mnemonic.text: en-（使）+ large（大）＝使变大，即扩大、放大；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: en-（使）+ large（大的，源自拉丁语 largus「宽大的、丰富的」）→ 古法语 enlargier → 中古英语 enlarge。

sensesIntro.en: Making something larger comes first, then growing larger by itself, and finally making an explanation larger with detail.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是把某物变大，再是自身变大，最后是用细节把解释「变大」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small image or space opening into a larger one.
core.cn: 核心意象：小小的影像或空间展开成更大的样子。

branches.en: Making something bigger is the literal transitive sense.
branches.cn: 使某物变大，是字面的及物义项。

branches.en: Becoming bigger is the same change seen from the object.
branches.cn: 自身变大，是从对象角度看的同一变化。

branches.en: Adding detail makes an idea bigger in explanation.
branches.cn: 补充细节，使解释中的想法「变大」。

branches.en: Both transitive and intransitive uses describe one size change.
branches.cn: 及物与不及物用法都描述同一次尺寸变化。

branches.en: Physical growth and expanded explanation both add extent.
branches.cn: 物理增长与解释扩展都增加「范围」。

intro.en: Enlarge is a French-shaped verb made from a prefix and the adjective large.
intro.cn: enlarge 是由前缀与形容词 large 构成的法语形态动词。

latinIntro.en: The prefix en- means to make, and large goes back to Latin largus, abundant or wide.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀 en- 表示使，large 上溯到拉丁语 largus（丰富的、宽大的）。

items.exampleCN: en- 出现在 enlarge 与 enable 开头。

items.example: Large is the base of enlarge.
items.exampleCN: large 是 enlarge 的基础词。

items.example: Largus is the distant source of large.
items.exampleCN: largus 是 large 的远源。

items.example: Enlargier brings the verb into English.
items.exampleCN: enlargier 把这个动词带入英语。
enlarge 由 en- 与 large 合成。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词词尾

definition_zh: 奖学金；学问；学识
definition_en: money given to support study, or serious academic learning
core_image: 一封录取信旁放着奖学金证书，桌上摊着厚厚的研究笔记
scene: 她凭优异成绩拿到了全额奖学金。 She won a full scholarship to study abroad.
sceneCN: 这里 scholarship 是「奖学金」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她获得了出国留学的全额奖学金。

senses.title: Study award
senses.definition: money given to a student to help pay for study
senses.definitionCN: 发给学生以资助学业的钱
senses.example: She applied for a scholarship to study abroad.
senses.exampleCN: 她申请了出国留学奖学金。
senses.why: The core sense is financial support for study.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是对学业的资助。

senses.title: Academic research
senses.definition: serious study and research in a subject
senses.definitionCN: 对某一学科进行的认真学习和研究
senses.example: His scholarship on ancient trade is well known.
senses.exampleCN: 他对古代贸易的研究广为人知。
senses.why: The award and the work share the same name.
senses.whyCN: 奖学金与学术工作共用同一个名称。

senses.title: Depth of learning
senses.definition: the level of knowledge and careful method a person shows
senses.definitionCN: 一个人所展现的知识水平与严谨方法
senses.example: The review praised the book's scholarship.
senses.exampleCN: 评论赞扬了这本书的学术水平。
senses.why: Research activity becomes a quality of the researcher.
senses.whyCN: 研究活动变成研究者的品质。

intro.en: Scholarship is scholar plus -ship, from Latin schola, school.
intro.cn: scholarship 由 scholar 加 -ship 构成，根源是拉丁语 schola（学校）。

items.en: Schola meant a school or learned discussion.
items.cn: schola 意为学校或学术讨论。

items.en: Scholaris meant of a school.
items.cn: scholaris 意为学校的。

items.en: Scoler meant a student or learned man.
items.cn: scoler 指学生或有学问的人。

items.en: Scholarship named the state or work of a scholar.
items.cn: scholarship 指学者的身份或工作。

items.en: Scholarship also names money awarded for study.
items.cn: 现代英语中 scholarship 也指用于资助学业的钱。

note.en: Scholarship is compared with similar forms and with words for study awards and learning.
note.cn: 把 scholarship 与形近形式以及表示奖学金和学问的词作比较。

entries.definition: a deep researcher
education at school
relating to learning
money given for a purpose
money for advanced study
a grant given to a student

normalIntro.en: Scholarship is what a scholar gets and what a scholar does.
normalIntro.cn: scholarship 既是学者得到的东西，也是学者做的事。

normal.en: Scholar plus ship: the ship carries money and learning.
normal.cn: scholar 加 ship：这艘船载着金钱与学问。

normal.en: A full scholarship pays all the study costs.
normal.cn: 全额奖学金支付全部学习费用。

normal.en: Academic scholarship means serious research work.
normal.cn: academic scholarship 意为严肃的学术研究。

normal.en: Win a scholarship and apply for a scholarship are common phrases.
normal.cn: win a scholarship 和 apply for a scholarship 都是常见搭配。

normal.en: The plural scholarships usually refers to awards.
normal.cn: 复数 scholarships 通常指多笔奖学金。

abstract.en: A scholarship buys time for thought.
abstract.cn: 奖学金为思考买来时间。

abstract.en: Money and learning share one word because each supports the other.
abstract.cn: 金钱与学问共用一个词，因为彼此支撑。

abstract.en: True scholarship outlives the award that funded it.
abstract.cn: 真正的学问比资助它的奖项更长久。

examples.en: The university offers scholarships to top students.
examples.cn: 这所大学为优秀学生提供奖学金。

examples.en: Her scholarship focuses on early medicine.
examples.cn: 她的学术研究聚焦早期医学。

examples.en: The book is admired for its careful scholarship.
examples.cn: 这本书因严谨的学术水平而受赞赏。

dict_mnemonic.text: scholar 加 -ship 构成 scholarship：既有「学者身份与学问」，也有资助学业的「奖学金」。

root: 由 scholar 加 -ship 构成，根源为拉丁语 schola（学校），核心义「与学者身份相关的资助与学问」。

sensesIntro.en: Scholarship means money for study, serious academic research, or depth of learning.
sensesIntro.cn: scholarship 意为奖学金、严肃的学术研究，或学识水平。

core.en: Support and work connected with being a scholar.
core.cn: 与学者身份相关的资助与工作。

branches.en: Money that supports a student's study.
branches.cn: 资助学生学业的钱。

branches.en: The serious research a scholar carries out.
branches.cn: 学者进行的严肃研究。

branches.en: The knowledge and method shown in the work.
branches.cn: 研究工作中展现的知识与方法。

branches.en: An award and research both belong to academic life.
branches.cn: 奖学金与研究都属于学术生活。

branches.en: Research work reveals the depth of learning.
branches.cn: 研究工作体现学识的深度。

intro.en: Scholarship ends the scholar family with -ship.
intro.cn: scholarship 以 -ship 收束 scholar 词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin schola, school, is the shared root.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 schola（学校）是共同词根。

items.meaning: a study award or academic work
items.exampleCN: 这笔奖学金改变了她的人生。

items.example: She wrote in a scholarly style.

items.exampleCN: 学业成功对他们很重要。
学校教育塑造了她的职业。

definition_zh: 向侧面地；斜着；侧着身子
definition_en: toward one side, or from the side
core_image: 螃蟹横着走，一步一步挪向旁边
scene: 人群很挤，他只能侧着身子往前挪。 He moved sideways through the crowd.
sceneCN: 这里 sideways 是「向侧面地」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他侧着身子穿过人群。

senses.title: Toward one side
senses.definition: in a direction to the left or right
senses.definitionCN: 朝左边或右边的方向
senses.example: He moved sideways through the crowd.
senses.exampleCN: 他侧着身子穿过人群。
senses.why: This is the basic direction sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的方向义项。

senses.title: From the side
senses.definition: turned so that the side faces forward
senses.definitionCN: 转过来让侧面对向前方
senses.example: She gave me a sideways glance.
senses.exampleCN: 她侧目看了我一眼。
senses.why: The direction becomes an angle of looking.
senses.whyCN: 方向义进一步变成观看的角度。

intro.en: Sideways joins side with the suffix -ways.
intro.cn: sideways 由 side 加上后缀 -ways 构成。

items.en: Side meant a flank or edge.
items.cn: side 意为侧面或边缘。

items.en: The suffix -ways marked direction.
items.cn: 后缀 -ways 表示方向。

items.en: The compound sideways meant toward the side.
items.cn: 复合词 sideways 意为朝侧面。

items.en: The adverb use became common.
items.cn: 副词用法变得普遍。

items.en: The adjective use described slanted things.
items.cn: 形容词用法用来描述倾斜的事物。

note.en: Sideways is compared with similar-looking words and with direction words.
note.cn: 把 sideways 与形近词以及方向词作比较。

entries.definition: a surface at the left or right
a small side path
to move quietly to one side
from side to side
at a slant
to one side

normalIntro.en: Sideways is side plus direction.
normalIntro.cn: sideways 就是侧面加上方向。

normal.en: He moved sideways through the crowd.
normal.cn: 他侧着身子穿过人群。

normal.en: She gave me a sideways glance.
normal.cn: 她侧目看了我一眼。

normal.en: The crab walks sideways.
normal.cn: 螃蟹横着走。

normal.en: Turn the frame sideways.
normal.cn: 把画框侧过来。

normal.en: Step sideways to let them pass.
normal.cn: 侧跨一步让他们过去。

abstract.en: Some answers arrive sideways.
abstract.cn: 有些答案是斜着到来的。

abstract.en: Progress is not always forward.
abstract.cn: 进步并不总是向前的。

abstract.en: A sideways look can see more.
abstract.cn: 侧目一看，反而看得更多。

examples.en: He moved sideways through the crowd.
examples.cn: 他侧着身子穿过人群。

examples.en: She gave me a sideways glance.
examples.cn: 她侧目看了我一眼。

examples.en: The crab walks sideways.
examples.cn: 螃蟹横着走。

dict_mnemonic.text: side（旁边）加 -ways（方向）：朝着旁边移动，就是 sideways。

root: 由 side（旁边）加 -ways（方向）构成，核心义「朝旁边」。

sensesIntro.en: Sideways means toward one side or from the side.
sensesIntro.cn: sideways 意为向侧面或从侧面。

core.en: Motion away from the straight line.
core.cn: 偏离直线的移动。

branches.en: He steps to the side.
branches.cn: 他向旁边迈步。

branches.en: A slanted look says more.
branches.cn: 斜着的一瞥说了更多。

branches.en: The crab moves across the sand.
branches.cn: 螃蟹横穿沙地。

branches.en: Direction and angle belong together.
branches.cn: 方向与角度彼此相连。

branches.en: An indirect gaze can be a comment.
branches.cn: 间接的注视也可以是一种评论。

intro.en: Sideways belongs to the side family of direction words.
intro.cn: sideways 属于侧向方向词族。

latinIntro.en: Sideways is Germanic; Latin latus, side, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: sideways 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 latus（侧面）只是语义对应词。

items.meaning: a quick look to the side
items.example: She shot him a sideways glance.

items.meaning: to take a step to the side
items.example: Step sideways and let the cart pass.

definition_zh: 混乱；无秩序；混沌
definition_en: a state of complete disorder, or the formless void believed to exist before the ordered world
core_image: 所有东西同时散落，找不到任何次序
scene: 停电后路口乱成一团。 Traffic fell into chaos after the lights failed.
sceneCN: 这里 chaos 指「混乱」（第 1 个义项：完全失去秩序的状态）；句意是信号灯失灵后交通陷入混乱。

senses.title: Complete disorder
senses.definition: a state in which everything is confused and has no order
senses.definitionCN: 一切事物都杂乱无章、毫无秩序的状态
senses.example: The office was in chaos after the move.
senses.exampleCN: 搬完之后办公室一片混乱。
senses.why: The Greek word named the void before creation, and any total loss of order recalls that void.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语原词指创世之前的虚空，任何彻底失序都让人想起那片虚空。

senses.title: The formless state before the world
senses.definition: the empty, formless state that Greek myth placed before the ordered universe
senses.definitionCN: 希腊神话置于有序宇宙之前的空虚无形状态
senses.example: Greek myths begin with chaos.
senses.exampleCN: 希腊神话从混沌开始。
senses.why: Hesiod used the word for the gap that opened before earth and sky were separated.
senses.whyCN: 赫西俄德用这个词指大地与天空分开之前张开的空隙。

senses.title: A jumble of unconnected things
senses.definition: a confused mass of objects or ideas with no pattern
senses.definitionCN: 毫无规律地堆在一起的物件或想法
senses.example: The desk was a chaos of papers and cups.
senses.exampleCN: 桌上是一堆杂乱的文件和杯子。
senses.why: A desk that loses every pattern is a small private copy of the original void.
senses.whyCN: 一张失去全部规律的桌子，就是那片原始虚空的小型私人翻版。

intro.en: Chaos is a Greek word for a gap or void, taken into English to name any total disorder.
intro.cn: chaos 是希腊语中表示裂缝或虚空的词，进入英语后指任何彻底的混乱。

items.en: Khaos meant a gap, chasm or empty space.
items.cn: 希腊语 khaos 意为裂缝、深渊或空旷之处。

items.en: Hesiod made Khaos the formless state before the gods.
items.cn: 赫西俄德把 khaos 写成众神之前的无形状态。

items.en: Latin chaos kept the cosmological sense of the void.
items.cn: 拉丁语 chaos 保留了虚空的宇宙论含义。

items.en: English chaos first described the state before creation.
items.cn: 英语 chaos 先描述创世之前的状态。

items.en: The word now also means any messy, uncontrolled situation.
items.cn: 如今该词也指任何杂乱失控的局面。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Greek stem, while the meaning group lists states of disorder.
note.cn: 形近组共享希腊语词干，近义组列出各种失序状态。

entries.definition: completely without order
a deep opening in the ground
the study of systems that look random
entries.definitionCN: 研究看似随机系统的学问

entries.definition: a lack of order
a state in which things are unclear
a dirty or untidy state

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the Greek void, the chaotic adjective and the phrase in chaos.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用希腊语虚空、形容词 chaotic 以及短语 in chaos。

normal.en: Chaos is the gap before the world, so a chaotic room has lost its order.
normal.cn: chaos 是世界之前的裂缝，所以 chaotic 的房间就是失去了次序。

normal.en: The adjective chaotic adds -ic, and the adverb adds -ally.
normal.cn: 形容词 chaotic 加 -ic，副词再在其后加 -ally。

normal.en: In chaos needs no article, because the noun is uncountable.
normal.cn: in chaos 不加冠词，因为这个词不可数。

normal.en: Chaos theory studies systems whose starting point decides everything.
normal.cn: chaos theory 研究起点决定一切的系统。

normal.en: A chaos of papers describes a heap with no pattern at all.
normal.cn: a chaos of papers 描述完全没有规律的一堆纸。

abstract.en: Picture a room where every drawer has been emptied at once.
abstract.cn: 想象一个房间，所有抽屉同时被倒空。

abstract.en: Picture a dark gap opening before the first light.
abstract.cn: 想象第一道光之前张开的黑暗裂缝。

abstract.en: Picture a crossroads with dead lights and honking cars.
abstract.cn: 想象一个信号灯全灭、汽车鸣笛的路口。

examples.en: The airport was in chaos after the storm.
examples.cn: 暴风雨过后机场一片混乱。

examples.en: He tried to bring order to the chaos of his notes.
examples.cn: 他试着把杂乱的笔记理出头绪。

examples.en: The old story says the world rose out of chaos.
examples.cn: 古老的故事说世界从混沌中升起。

dict_mnemonic.text: chaos 读起来像「吵死」：一群人吵得不可开交，场面就是一片混乱。

root: 源自希腊语 khaos（裂缝、虚空），经拉丁语 chaos 进入英语，由「创世前的无形虚空」引申为彻底的混乱。

sensesIntro.en: The empty gap before creation gives the mythic sense first, then any total disorder, then a mere jumble.
sensesIntro.cn: 创世前的空虚先给出神话义，再给出彻底的混乱，最后给出普通的一堆杂物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a formless gap where nothing has its place.
core.cn: 核心意象：万物都找不到位置的无形空隙。

branches.en: A chaotic office has lost every pattern.
branches.cn: 混乱的办公室失去了全部规律。

branches.en: Myth places chaos before earth and sky.
branches.cn: 神话把混沌放在天地之前。

branches.en: A heap of papers is chaos on a small scale.
branches.cn: 一堆纸是缩小尺度的混乱。

branches.en: Both senses share the idea of no order at all.
branches.cn: 两个义项都共享「全无秩序」的意思。

branches.en: The everyday mess echoes the cosmic void.
branches.cn: 日常的杂乱呼应着宇宙的虚空。

intro.en: Chaos forms chaotic and chaotically with the adjective and adverb endings.
intro.cn: chaos 借助形容词与副词词尾构成 chaotic 与 chaotically。

latinIntro.en: The word passed from Greek khaos into Latin chaos before reaching English.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词从希腊语 khaos 进入拉丁语 chaos，再到英语。

items.meaning: a deep gap in the earth
items.example: A chasm opened in the road.

latinEntries.example: Latin chaos kept the Greek sense.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 chaos 保留了希腊语义。

definition_zh: 间接地；迂回地；不直接地
definition_en: in a way that is not direct or is not stated openly
core_image: 水从山上的池子顺着沟渠，绕两户人家的墙，才流进自家的菜地
scene: 有些好处不是直接拿到的，而是通过别的渠道得来。 He indirectly helped me get the job.
sceneCN: 这里 indirectly 是「间接地」（第 1 个义项：不经直接方式）；句意是他间接帮我得到了那份工作。

pos.zh: 副词：间接地；迂回地；不直接地

forms.label: 无变化（副词无词形变化）

derivatives.zh: 义为「间接的」，是本词的形容词形式
义为「直接地」，去掉 in- 即成反义
义为「一……就」，与形容词 direct 同根

senses.title: Through someone or something else
senses.titleCN: 间接地：经由他人或他物
senses.definition: by means of another person or thing rather than by oneself
senses.definitionCN: 通过他人或他物，而非自己直接完成
senses.example: He indirectly helped me get the job.
senses.exampleCN: 他间接帮我得到了那份工作。
senses.why: The -ly adverb carries the detour of indirect into the manner of an action, so the action arrives by a middle step.
senses.whyCN: -ly 副词把 indirect 的绕行带进动作的方式，动作便经由中间环节到达。

senses.title: Not said in plain words
senses.definition: in a way that suggests rather than states
senses.definitionCN: 以暗示而非直陈的方式表达
senses.example: She indirectly referred to his mistake at dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 晚饭时她间接提到了他的失误。
senses.why: Speech has its own detours, and the adverb lets a speaker step around the blunt phrase.
senses.whyCN: 话语也有自己的绕行，副词让说话人绕开那句不客气的话。

senses.title: As a secondary consequence
senses.titleCN: 间接地：作为次生的结果
senses.definition: as a result that follows through another event
senses.definitionCN: 作为经由另一事件而生的结果
senses.example: The strike indirectly raised prices across the region.
senses.exampleCN: 罢工间接抬高了整个地区的物价。
senses.why: Effects often travel through a chain, and the adverb marks the distance from cause to result.
senses.whyCN: 效果常经一条链条传递，副词标出因与果之间的距离。

senses.title: Through light or influence, not contact
senses.titleCN: 间接地：经光或影响，而非接触
senses.definition: of light or influence, reaching something through a surface or a third party
senses.definitionCN: 指光或影响经表面或第三方到达某处
senses.example: The room is lit indirectly by a lamp turned to the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 房间由一盏对着墙的灯间接照明。
senses.why: Physics and social life share the same image: something arrives without touching.
senses.whyCN: 物理与社会生活共用同一意象：某物未直接接触却已抵达。

intro.en: Indirectly is indirect plus the adverb ending -ly, built in English on Latin materials.
intro.cn: indirectly 是 indirect 加副词词尾 -ly，在英语中用拉丁材料构词。

items.en: Dirigere, to set straight, lay behind directus.
items.cn: dirigere「使之笔直」是 directus 的来源。

items.en: Indirectus named what is not straight.
items.cn: indirectus 用来命名不直的东西。

items.en: English borrowed indirect and soon added -ly for manner.
items.cn: 英语借入 indirect，很快又加 -ly 表方式。

items.en: The adverb spread into science, law and careful reports.
items.cn: 这个副词扩散到科学、法律与谨慎的报道中。

items.en: Modern prose uses it to hedge about responsibility.
items.cn: 现代文章用它来对责任作出保留。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the direct family; the near-meaning group holds adverbs of roundabout manner.
note.cn: 形近组共用 direct 词族；近义组收表示迂回方式的副词。

entries.definition: Not going straight or not said plainly.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「间接的」，是本词的基础。

entries.definition: In a straight way, or at once.
Going straight or said plainly.
In an indirect or evasive way.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「含沙射影地、间接地」。

entries.definition: In a way that is suggested but not stated.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「含蓄地、暗示地」。

entries.definition: By way of another person rather than directly.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「经他人转手地」。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the ditch that carries water around two walls and the hedged sentence in a report.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子借绕两道墙的水渠，以及报道里留有余地的话。

normal.en: Indirect plus -ly: the bend in the road becomes the bend in the way you do something.
normal.cn: indirect 加 -ly：路上的弯，变成了做事方式上的弯。

normal.en: If someone helps you indirectly, you may never learn what the favour cost them.
normal.cn: 别人间接帮你，你可能永远不知道这份人情花了对方什么。

normal.en: Reports use it to save a face: the mistake is mentioned, but no name is said.
normal.cn: 报道用它为面子留余地：错误提到了，名字没提。

normal.en: An indirectly lit room has no shadow of the lamp you can point to.
normal.cn: 间接照明的房间里，你指不出灯的影子。

normal.en: Directly moves in a line; indirectly moves along the line of the land.
normal.cn: directly 走直线，indirectly 顺着地形的线走。

abstract.en: Most of what shapes a life arrives indirectly, through chance and other people.
abstract.cn: 塑造一生的东西多半间接而来，经由偶然与他人。

abstract.en: To act indirectly is to trust that the middle steps will not break.
abstract.cn: 间接地做事，等于相信中间环节不会断。

abstract.en: The adverb hides the agent, and hiding the agent is how responsibility is thinned.
abstract.cn: 这个副词藏起施动者，而藏起施动者正是稀释责任的方法。

examples.en: Many jobs are created indirectly by small firms.
examples.cn: 许多岗位是由小公司间接创造出来的。

examples.en: She indirectly blamed the weather for the delay.
examples.cn: 她间接地把延误归咎于天气。

examples.en: The plants benefit indirectly from the shade of the trees.
examples.cn: 这些植物从树荫中间接受益。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「印的瑞克特利」——印刷单上写的路径又绕又弯，只能间接地到。

root: 拉丁语 in-（不）+ dirigere（使之笔直）+ -ly（副词词尾）；同根词 direct、directly、direction。

sensesIntro.en: Indirectly turns the bent line of indirect into a manner: whatever happens arrives through someone, through speech, through a chain of events or through a surface.
sensesIntro.cn: indirectly 把 indirect 的弯线变成方式：发生的事都要经由他人、话语、事件链条或某个表面才能到达。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ditch carrying water around two walls to reach a garden.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条绕过两道墙、把水送进菜地的水渠。

branches.en: AGENT LINE: something is done by a middle person.
branches.cn: 施动线：某事由中间人完成。

branches.en: SPEECH LINE: the meaning comes around the words.
branches.cn: 话语线：意思绕过字面而来。

branches.en: CHAIN LINE: the result follows another event.
branches.cn: 链条线：结果跟在另一事件之后。

branches.en: SURFACE LINE: light or influence comes off a wall.
branches.cn: 表面线：光与影响从墙上反射而来。

branches.en: RESPONSIBILITY LINE: the adverb softens blame.
branches.cn: 责任线：副词让责难变轻。

intro.en: A negative prefix, a straight-line root and an adverb ending travelling together.
intro.cn: 否定前缀、直线词根与副词词尾一起出行。

latinIntro.en: Latin in- plus dirigere gave indirectus; English added -ly.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 in- 加 dirigere 得 indirectus，英语再加 -ly。

definition_zh: 漠不关心的；冷淡的；平庸的
definition_en: not interested in or caring about something, or not especially good
core_image: 一个人坐在雨里看报，衣服湿透了也不抬头
scene: 投票那天，最怕听到的一句话是「都一样」。 Most young people are indifferent to local elections.
sceneCN: 这里 indifferent 是「漠不关心」（第 1 个义项：不感兴趣、不在意）；句意是多数年轻人对地方选举漠不关心。

pos.zh: 形容词：漠不关心的；冷淡的；平庸的

derivatives.zh: 义为「冷漠、漠然」，由本词加 -ence 构成
义为「不同的」，与本词同根

senses.title: Not caring about something
senses.titleCN: 漠不关心：对该在意的事不在意
senses.definition: having no interest in or sympathy for something
senses.definitionCN: 对某事没有兴趣或同情
senses.example: Most young people are indifferent to local elections.
senses.exampleCN: 多数年轻人对地方选举漠不关心。
senses.why: The Latin word means making no difference, and a person who feels no difference does not care.
senses.whyCN: 这个词在拉丁语里意为「不造成差别」，而感觉不出差别的人自然就不关心。

senses.title: Unmoved by praise or blame
senses.titleCN: 无动于衷：不为褒贬所动
senses.definition: not influenced or excited by something that moves others
senses.definitionCN: 不被能打动他人的事物所影响或激起
senses.example: He seemed indifferent to fame.
senses.exampleCN: 他似乎对名声无动于衷。
senses.why: Stoic calm and coldness share the same shape, so the word can praise or blame.
senses.whyCN: 淡泊与冷淡形状相同，因此这个词既可用于褒也可用于贬。

senses.title: Neither good nor bad
senses.definition: of only average quality, nothing special
senses.definitionCN: 质量只属一般，没有特别之处
senses.example: The food was indifferent but cheap.
senses.exampleCN: 饭菜平平，但便宜。
senses.why: If something makes no difference to you, it is neither impressive nor bad.
senses.whyCN: 如果某物对你造不成差别，它就既不出色也不糟糕。

senses.title: In science, having no effect
senses.titleCN: 无影响的：科学中不产生作用
senses.definition: in older scientific use, producing no effect or not varying
senses.definitionCN: 在旧式科学用语中，指不产生效果或不变化
senses.example: An indifferent gas does not react with the mixture.
senses.exampleCN: 惰性气体不与混合物反应。
senses.why: A substance that makes no difference to a reaction earns the same word as a careless person.
senses.whyCN: 对反应不起作用的物质与人所得的评价，竟是同一个词。

intro.en: Indifferent is in-, not, plus different, from Latin differre, to carry apart, to differ.
intro.cn: indifferent 是 in-（不）加 different，后者源自拉丁语 differre「分开携带、相异」。

items.en: Differre meant to carry apart and, by extension, to differ.
items.cn: differre 意为分开携带，引申为「相异」。

items.en: Indifferens meant making no difference between things, neither this nor that.
items.cn: indifferens 意为「不作区分」，既非此也非彼。

items.en: English first used it for undecided or neutral matters such as taste.
items.cn: 英语最初用它形容口味之类无关紧要、无可无不可的事。

items.en: The word shifted from neutral to not caring, a colder judgement.
items.cn: 词义从「中性」滑向「不关心」，评价变得更冷。

items.en: It kept the older sense of ordinary quality in phrases such as indifferent food.
items.cn: 在 indifferent food 这类说法里，它保留了「质量一般」的旧义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the differ- root; the near-meaning group holds words for coldness of feeling.
note.cn: 形近组共用 differ- 词根；近义组收表示感情冷淡的词。

entries.definition: Not the same as another.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「不同的」，去掉 in- 即成。

entries.definition: A lack of interest or concern.
In a cold or mediocre way.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「冷淡地；平平地」。

entries.definition: Not worried or interested.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「不关心的、不在意的」。

entries.definition: Showing no friendly feeling.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「冷淡的」，更口语。

entries.definition: Separate and not emotionally involved.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「超然的、抽离的」。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the no-difference reading, the neutral-to-cold shift and the mediocre meal.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子借「无差别」的字面义、由中性转冷淡的漂移与那顿平庸的饭。

normal.en: In plus different: if nothing is different to you, you do not care which one happens.
normal.cn: in 加 different：什么对你都一样，你就不在意发生哪一个。

normal.en: Being indifferent is not the same as being different; one word means the difference has vanished.
normal.cn: indifferent 不是 different：前者说的是差别消失了。

normal.en: Indifferent food is neither good nor bad, because it makes no difference to your evening.
normal.cn: indifferent food 不好也不坏，因为它对你的这个晚上毫无影响。

normal.en: The noun is indifference, the letter e replaces the final t, like different and difference.
normal.cn: 名词是 indifference，结尾 t 换成 e，正如 different 与 difference。

normal.en: A man reading in the rain is the picture: the world is wet, he is not moved.
normal.cn: 雨里看报的人就是这幅画面：世界湿透了，他毫不动容。

abstract.en: Indifference is freedom from concern, which is either wisdom or irresponsibility.
abstract.cn: 漠然是从牵挂中脱身，它要么是智慧，要么是不负责任。

abstract.en: The opposite of love is not hate but not caring which way things go.
abstract.cn: 爱的反面不是恨，而是不在意事情往哪儿走。

abstract.en: To say something makes no difference is already a decision about it.
abstract.cn: 说某事无关紧要，本身就已经是有关它的一个决定。

examples.en: She was indifferent to the praise and kept working.
examples.cn: 她对赞扬毫不在意，继续工作。

examples.en: The service at the hotel was indifferent.
examples.cn: 那家旅馆的服务很一般。

examples.en: No one can remain indifferent to such suffering.
examples.cn: 面对这样的苦难，没有人能无动于衷。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「印地分润」——分红时分给谁他都一样，事不关己，便漠不关心。

root: 拉丁语 in-（不）+ differre（分开携带、相异）→ indifferens（不作区分）；同根词有 different、differ、difference、ferry。

sensesIntro.en: Indifferent starts as a statement that no difference is made, turns into not caring, and slides from there into both coldness of feeling and ordinary quality.
sensesIntro.cn: indifferent 起初只是说「不造成差别」，随后变为「不关心」，再由此滑向感情冷淡与质量平平。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: someone reading a newspaper in the rain, never looking up.
core.cn: 核心意象：有人在雨里看报，从不抬头。

branches.en: APATHY LINE: the outcome no longer matters to someone.
branches.cn: 冷漠线：结果对某人不再重要。

branches.en: STOIC LINE: praise and blame move nobody.
branches.cn: 淡泊线：褒与贬都打不动人。

branches.en: QUALITY LINE: what moves no one is merely average.
branches.cn: 质量线：打不动人的东西也只是平常。

branches.en: CHEMISTRY LINE: a substance that changes nothing.
branches.cn: 化学线：不改变任何东西的物质。

branches.en: JUDGEMENT LINE: the same word praises calm and blames carelessness.
branches.cn: 评判线：同一个词既赞沉静也责疏忽。

intro.en: A negative prefix on a verb meaning to differ, with a participial adjective ending.
intro.cn: 否定前缀加在表示「相异」的动词上，再接分词形容词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin in-, not, plus differre, to carry apart, plus -ens gave indifferens.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 in-「不」加 differre「分开携带」加 -ens，构成 indifferens。

items.example: the root of transfer and refer
items.exampleCN: transfer 与 refer 的词根

definition_zh: 鹰；雕；鹰徽；鹰眼般的锐利目光；（高尔夫）老鹰球
definition_en: a large bird of prey with keen sight and powerful wings, a figure of such a bird used as an emblem, or a golf score of two strokes under par
core_image: 高空中展开双翼的猛禽，目光锁住地面上的猎物
scene: 山脊上的风把云推成一列，一只猛禽贴着上升气流盘旋。 The eagle circled above the valley without a single beat of its wings.
sceneCN: 这里 eagle 是「鹰、雕」（第 1 个义项：目光锐利的大型猛禽）；句意为那只鹰一次翅膀都没扇，就在山谷上空盘旋。图中可辨识物件：山脊、上升气流、展开的双翼。

pos.zh: 动词：在高尔夫球中打出老鹰球

derivatives.zh: 由本词加指小后缀构成，义为「雏鹰」
由本词与 eyed 复合构成，义为「目光锐利的」

senses.title: A large bird of prey
senses.definition: a large strong bird that hunts smaller animals, with a hooked beak, sharp talons and very keen eyesight
senses.definitionCN: 捕食小型动物的大型强壮鸟类，有钩状的喙、尖利的爪和极敏锐的视力
senses.example: The eagle spotted a rabbit from a height of three hundred metres.
senses.exampleCN: 那只鹰从三百米高处发现了兔子。
senses.why: The Latin noun aquila named the bird first; the hooked beak and the far-seeing eye are the whole image behind the word.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语名词 aquila 先给这种鸟命了名；钩状的喙与远望的眼睛就是这个词背后的全部意象。

senses.title: An emblem on flags and coins
senses.titleCN: 徽记：旗徽与币面上的鹰
senses.definition: a representation of an eagle used as a national, military or family emblem
senses.definitionCN: 用作国家、军队或家族标志的鹰的形象
senses.example: The coin carries an eagle on one side and a shield on the other.
senses.exampleCN: 这枚硬币一面是鹰，另一面是盾。
senses.why: Because the bird looks dominant and far-seeing, states put its picture on flags and coins to claim those same qualities.
senses.whyCN: 因为这鸟显得强势而远望，国家把它的形象印上旗帜与钱币，借以宣称自己也有这样的品质。

senses.title: Two strokes under par
senses.definition: a score of two strokes under par on a single hole
senses.definitionCN: 在单个球洞比标准杆少两杆的成绩
senses.example: She holed her second shot for an eagle on the par-five.
senses.exampleCN: 她在五杆洞第二杆直接入洞，打出老鹰球。
senses.why: Golf borrows bird names for scores below par, and the eagle ranks above the birdie because two under par is the rarer feat.
senses.whyCN: 高尔夫借用鸟名来称呼低于标准杆的成绩，老鹰球比小鸟球高一级，因为少两杆更罕见。

senses.title: The eagle eye
senses.definition: in the phrase eagle eye, an extremely keen ability to notice small details
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 eagle eye，指察觉细小事物时极敏锐的能力
senses.example: The inspector kept an eagle eye on every invoice.
senses.exampleCN: 检查员以鹰一般的锐利目光盯着每一张发票。
senses.why: The bird's sight is the source of the idiom: to watch as an eagle watches is to miss nothing.
senses.whyCN: 这鸟的视力是这条习语的来源：像鹰那样看，就是什么都不漏。

intro.en: Eagle is a Latin borrowing that reached English through French, and its emblem sense was already present in Roman use.
intro.cn: eagle 是经由法语进入英语的拉丁语借词，徽记义在罗马时期就已存在。

items.en: A root for 'bird of prey' is sometimes reconstructed, but its exact shape and meaning are uncertain.
items.cn: 有时会重构一个表示「猛禽」的词根，但其确切形态与含义不确定。

items.en: Aquila was the ordinary Latin word for the eagle and also the name of the Roman military standard.
items.cn: aquila 是拉丁语中「鹰」的常用词，同时也是罗马军旗的名称。

items.en: Old French aigle came from the Latin form and carried both the bird and its heraldic use.
items.cn: 古法语 aigle 由拉丁语形式而来，同时带上「鸟」与纹章用法的含义。

items.en: Middle English used eagle beside older native names for the bird; the borrowed form eventually won out.
items.cn: 中古英语用 eagle，同时也用更早的本族词指这种鸟；借词形式最终胜出。

items.en: The golf sense is much later: sport borrowed the bird names to rank scores below par.
items.cn: 高尔夫义出现得晚得多：这项运动借用鸟名来给低于标准杆的成绩分等级。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms built on the same bird word; the near-meaning group gathers other raptors whose size and habits differ.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「鹰」词构成的形式；近义组收其他猛禽，体型与习性各有不同。

entries.definition: A young eagle, formed with a small noun suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 雏鹰，由本词加指小名词后缀构成。

entries.definition: An adjective describing someone who notices everything.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，形容人目光锐利、什么都不漏。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning eagle-like, especially of a hooked nose.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「鹰一般的」，尤指钩形鼻。

entries.definition: A smaller daytime hunting bird with broad wings and a shorter beak.
entries.definitionCN: 一种体型较小的昼行猛禽，翼宽喙短。

entries.definition: A fast hunting bird with long pointed wings, often trained for falconry.
entries.definitionCN: 一种飞速快、翼长而尖的猎鸟，常被训练用于鹰猎。

normalIntro.en: These hooks climb from the bird on a thermal to the emblem, the golf score and the sharp eye.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子从乘着上升气流盘旋的鸟，一路攀到徽记、高尔夫成绩与锐利目光。

normal.en: An eagle holds its wings still and lets rising air do the work.
normal.cn: 鹰把双翼展开不动，让上升的空气替它出力。

normal.en: The same bird sits on flags and coins because people want its reach and its stare.
normal.cn: 同一只鸟被放上旗帜与钱币，因为人们想要它的视野与凝视。

normal.en: Golf ranks birds by rarity, and two under par earns the eagle.
normal.cn: 高尔夫按罕见程度给鸟排名，少两杆才配得上老鹰。

normal.en: An eagle eye misses nothing, which is why inspectors are said to have one.
normal.cn: 鹰眼什么都不漏，所以人们说检查员长着一双鹰眼。

normal.en: Eagle and eaglet differ only in size, just as the words differ by one suffix.
normal.cn: eagle 与 eaglet 只差体型，两个词也只差一个后缀。

abstract.en: Picture a wide V of wings pinned above a valley, eyes locked on one moving dot.
abstract.cn: 想象山谷上方钉着一个宽大的 V 形双翼，眼睛死盯一个移动的小点。

abstract.en: The same V can be stitched on a flag, stamped on a coin or drawn on a scorecard.
abstract.cn: 同一个 V 形可以绣上旗帜、压进硬币，也可以画在记分卡上。

abstract.en: Eagle means height, command and unhurried sight, whichever object carries it.
abstract.cn: 无论载体是什么，eagle 都意味着高度、掌控与不急不躁的目力。

examples.en: The eagle nested on the cliff for more than a decade.
examples.cn: 那只鹰在悬崖上筑巢十多年了。

examples.en: A bald eagle appears on the back of the coin.
examples.cn: 硬币背面有一只白头鹰。

examples.en: He hit an eagle on the last hole and won by one stroke.
examples.cn: 他在最后一洞打出老鹰球，以一杆优势获胜。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「伊格」——头顶一个钩喙，盘旋着盯住草地的兔子：鹰

root: 拉丁语 aquila「鹰」经由古法语 aigle 进入英语，aquila 同时是罗马军旗的名称。更早的印欧语来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses of eagle all start from one bird: the animal itself, its use as a sign, a golf score named after it, and the keen gaze people borrow from it.
sensesIntro.cn: eagle 的四个义项都从同一只鸟出发：鸟本身、被当作标志的鸟、以它命名的老鹰球，以及人们从它借来的锐利目光。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a great bird hangs on rising air, eyes fixed on a rabbit far below.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只大鸟挂在上升的气流里，眼睛死盯下方很远处的一只兔子。

branches.en: THE BIRD: the animal itself, defined by hooked beak, talons and sight.
branches.cn: 鸟线：这种动物本身，以钩喙、利爪与视力为特征。

branches.en: THE SIGN: the bird's dominance is borrowed for flags, coins and family arms.
branches.cn: 标志线：人们借用这鸟的强势，把它放上旗帜、钱币与家族纹章。

branches.en: THE SCORE: sport takes the bird's name for a rare result under par.
branches.cn: 成绩线：运动借这鸟的名字，称呼低于标准杆的罕见成绩。

branches.en: THE GAZE: everyday speech takes the bird's sight as a model for noticing everything.
branches.cn: 目光线：日常语言把这鸟的视力当作「什么都不漏」的样板。

branches.en: THE EYE AUTHORITY: both the animal and the idiom rest on the same claim, that nothing escapes that stare.
branches.cn: 目力权威线：动物义与习语义都建立在同一个说法上——什么都逃不过那道凝视。

intro.en: Eagle is a Latin borrowing through French, so English adds only small suffixes and compounds to the borrowed stem.
intro.cn: eagle 是经由法语而来的拉丁语借词，英语只在借来的词干上加小后缀与复合成分。

latinIntro.en: Latin aquila and its use for the military standard are recorded; only the deeper Indo-European root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 aquila 及其军旗用法均有文献记录，只有更早的印欧语词根属于重构形式。

items.example: The noun already joined the bird and the standard.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词已经把「鸟」与「军旗」合在一起。
这个词根出现在 aquiline 里。

items.meaning: having eyes of a stated kind

items.example: The phrase works as a fixed idiom.
items.exampleCN: 这个短语作为固定习语使用。

items.example: The compound names one particular species.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词专指一个物种。

definition_zh: 履行；满足；实现
definition_en: to do what is required or promised, or to make a hope real
core_image: 医生接过证书，终于实现了多年的梦想
scene: 他最终实现了成为医生的梦想。 He finally fulfilled his dream of becoming a doctor.
sceneCN: 这里 fulfill 是「实现」（第 3 个义项）；句意：他最终实现了成为医生的梦想。

derivatives.zh: 自我实现的；自我应验的

senses.title: Do what was promised
senses.definition: to do what you promised or are required to do
senses.definitionCN: 去做自己承诺或必须做的事
senses.example: She fulfilled her promise to visit every week.
senses.exampleCN: 她履行了每周探望的承诺。
senses.why: This is the duty sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是义务层面的义项。

senses.title: Meet a need or rule
senses.definition: to satisfy a need, condition, or standard
senses.definitionCN: 满足需要、条件或标准
senses.example: The design fulfills all safety requirements.
senses.exampleCN: 这个设计符合所有安全要求。
senses.why: Here the object is a condition, not a promise.
senses.whyCN: 这里宾语是条件，而不是承诺。

senses.title: Make a hope real
senses.definition: to make a hope, dream, or aim become real
senses.definitionCN: 使希望、梦想或目标成为现实
senses.example: He finally fulfilled his dream of becoming a doctor.
senses.exampleCN: 他最终实现了成为医生的梦想。
senses.why: This is the hopeful, forward-looking sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是充满希望、面向未来的义项。

intro.en: Fulfill is an old English compound of full and fill.
intro.cn: fulfill 是古英语中 full 与 fill 的复合词。

items.en: Fullfyllan meant to fill up completely.
items.cn: fullfyllan 意为完全装满。

items.en: The form became fulfillen.
items.cn: 词形演变为 fulfillen。

items.en: It came to mean carrying out a promise.
items.cn: 它开始表示履行承诺。

items.en: It also meant meeting a condition.
items.cn: 它也意为满足条件。

items.en: The sense of realizing a dream grew.
items.cn: 「实现梦想」的义项发展起来。

note.en: Fulfill is compared with look-alike words and words for completing.
note.cn: 把 fulfill 与形近词以及表示完成的词作比较。

entries.definition: holding as much as possible
to make something full
to pass liquid through a screen
to finish doing something
to meet a need or wish
to succeed in reaching a goal

normalIntro.en: To fulfill is to fill a promise or a dream until it is full.
normalIntro.cn: fulfill 就是把承诺或梦想填满，直到成真。

normal.en: He finally fulfilled his dream of becoming a doctor.
normal.cn: 他最终实现了成为医生的梦想。

normal.en: She fulfilled her promise to visit every week.
normal.cn: 她履行了每周探望的承诺。

normal.en: The design fulfills all safety requirements.
normal.cn: 这个设计符合所有安全要求。

normal.en: The shop fulfills orders within two days.
normal.cn: 这家店两天内完成订单。

normal.en: He felt his work was fulfilling.
normal.cn: 他觉得自己的工作很有满足感。

abstract.en: A promise is a debt that only action can pay.
abstract.cn: 承诺是只有行动才能偿还的债。

abstract.en: A dream fulfilled often looks like ordinary work done daily.
abstract.cn: 实现的梦想常常看起来像每天做的普通工作。

abstract.en: Fulfillment comes from finishing what matters.
abstract.cn: 满足感来自完成真正重要的事。

examples.en: He finally fulfilled his dream of becoming a doctor.
examples.cn: 他最终实现了成为医生的梦想。

examples.en: She fulfilled her promise to visit every week.
examples.cn: 她履行了每周探望的承诺。

examples.en: The design fulfills all safety requirements.
examples.cn: 这个设计符合所有安全要求。

dict_mnemonic.text: fulfill = full（满）+ fill（填）；英式拼写也可作 fulfil，名词是 fulfillment。

root: 源自古英语 fullfyllan，由 full（满）与 fill（填）组成；核心义「填满、完成」。

sensesIntro.en: Fulfill means keeping a promise, meeting a requirement, or making a dream real.
sensesIntro.cn: fulfill 意为履行承诺、满足要求，或使梦想成真。

core.en: Filling something until it is complete.
core.cn: 把某物填满直至完成。

branches.en: A promise is kept by doing it.
branches.cn: 承诺靠行动来兑现。

branches.en: A rule is met by meeting its terms.
branches.cn: 通过满足条款来符合规则。

branches.en: A long hope finally becomes real.
branches.cn: 长久的希望终于成真。

branches.en: Promises and conditions both demand completion.
branches.cn: 承诺与条件都要求完成。

branches.en: Meeting each requirement allows the dream.
branches.cn: 满足每项要求才能让梦想实现。

intro.en: Fulfill forms words for completion and satisfaction.
intro.cn: fulfill 构成表示完成与满足的词。

latinIntro.en: Fulfill is a native English compound, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: fulfill 是英语本族复合词，并非拉丁语。

items.example: He felt fulfilled after the concert.
items.exampleCN: 音乐会后他感到很满足。
教书是一份令人满足的工作。

items.meaning: the act of completing or the feeling of satisfaction
items.example: The work gives her great fulfillment.
items.exampleCN: 这份工作给她极大的满足感。

items.example: He fulfilled a promise to his father.
items.exampleCN: 他履行了对父亲的承诺。

items.example: She fulfilled a dream by sailing alone.
items.exampleCN: 她独自航行，实现了梦想。
这个计划满足所有要求。

definition_zh: 协调；使配合；坐标；同等的
definition_en: to make different parts work well together, a position on a map, or equal in rank
core_image: 几路人马在同一张时间表上对齐，指针同时指向一处
scene: 几支队伍先后赶来，负责人先把时间和路线排好。 She coordinated the rescue from a small tent.
sceneCN: 这里 coordinate 指「协调」（第 1 个义项：让不同部分配合起来）；句意是她在一个小帐篷里协调这次救援。

senses.title: To bring parts into step
senses.definition: to arrange different people or parts so that they work well together
senses.definitionCN: 安排不同的人或部分，使其配合良好
senses.example: She coordinated the work of four teams.
senses.exampleCN: 她协调了四个团队的工作。
senses.why: Separate clocks tell separate times until one hand sets them all.
senses.whyCN: 各自走时的钟各说各话，直到有一只手把它们调齐。

senses.title: A position on a grid
senses.definition: one of the numbers that fix a point on a map or graph
senses.definitionCN: 在地图或图表上确定一个点的数值之一
senses.example: The ship sent its coordinates by radio.
senses.exampleCN: 这艘船用无线电发出了坐标。
senses.why: Two numbers can pin down one exact spot in a wide world.
senses.whyCN: 两个数字就能在广阔世界里钉住一个确切的点。

senses.title: Equal in rank
senses.definition: having the same level or importance as another thing
senses.definitionCN: 与另一事物处于相同层级或同等重要
senses.example: The two clauses are coordinate in grammar.
senses.exampleCN: 这两个分句在语法上是并列的。
senses.why: Things set side by side stand on one level.
senses.whyCN: 并排放置的东西，站在同一个高度上。

intro.en: Coordinate comes from Latin co-, together, and ordinare, to arrange, from ordo, order or row.
intro.cn: coordinate 来自拉丁语 co-（一起）与 ordinare（排列），词根 ordo 意为次序、行列。

items.en: Ordo meant a row, a rank or a settled order.
items.cn: ordo 意为行列、等级或既定次序。

items.en: Ordinare meant to set things in rows and put them in order.
items.cn: ordinare 意为把事物排成行、理出次序。

items.en: Coordinare meant to arrange several things together.
items.cn: coordinare 意为把几样事物一同排列。

items.en: English coordinate first described things of equal rank.
items.cn: 英语 coordinate 最初形容等级相同的事物。

items.en: Mathematics gave the noun the sense of a fixed position.
items.cn: 数学赋予这个名词固定位置的含义。

items.en: The verb now mostly means to bring work into step.
items.cn: 今天动词主要表示把工作安排得彼此合拍。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin ordering base ordin-, and the meaning group names other verbs of making things fit.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的排列词基 ordin-，近义组列出其他使事物相合的说法。

entries.definition: the act of making parts work together
entries.definitionCN: 让各部分配合起来的做法

entries.definition: a person who brings work together
lower in rank than another
to arrange things into a working whole
entries.definitionCN: 把事物安排成一个运作的整体

entries.definition: to make things happen at the same time
to bring things into a straight line or agreement
entries.definitionCN: 使事物成一直线或达成一致

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with several clocks set to one time, then move to numbers fixing a spot and to things standing level.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从几只被调成同一时间的钟开始，再到确定位置的数字，最后到站在同一高度的事物。

normal.en: Co- is together and ordinate is arranged in order, so coordinate is to put things in one order.
normal.cn: co- 是一起，ordinate 是排成次序，coordinate 就是把事物排进同一个次序。

normal.en: Think of a conductor who never plays a note but keeps everyone together.
normal.cn: 想象一位指挥家，自己不奏一个音，却让所有人合在一起。

normal.en: Two numbers on a map are also a kind of order.
normal.cn: 地图上的两个数字，也是一种次序。

normal.en: The same word means to arrange and to stand at the same level.
normal.cn: 同一个词既表示安排，也表示处在同一层级。

normal.en: Remember co- means together in all three senses.
normal.cn: 记住三个义项里都藏着 co- 的一起。

abstract.en: Picture four clocks hung in a row, all showing one time.
abstract.cn: 想象四只钟挂成一排，都指向同一个时间。

abstract.en: Picture a cross on a map with two numbers beside it.
abstract.cn: 想象地图上一个十字，旁边写着两个数字。

abstract.en: Picture two blocks placed side by side at one height.
abstract.cn: 想象两块积木并排放在同一高度。

examples.en: She coordinated the whole event by phone.
examples.cn: 她通过电话协调了整个活动。

examples.en: Write down the coordinates before you move.
examples.cn: 行动之前先把坐标记下来。

examples.en: The two departments work as coordinate units.
examples.cn: 这两个部门作为同级单位合作。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 coordinate 记成 co（一起）加 ordin（次序）加 ate：把事情排进同一个次序，就是协调。

root: 源自拉丁语 coordinare（一同排列），由 co-（一起）与 ordinare（排列）构成，词根 ordo 意为次序，后兼指坐标与同级。

sensesIntro.en: From clocks set to one time, to numbers fixing a spot, and at last to things standing on one level.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被调成同一时间的钟，到确定一个点的数字，最后到站在同一层级的事物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: several hands setting clocks to one time.
core.cn: 核心意象：几只手把钟调到同一个时间。

branches.en: Separate efforts are brought into one rhythm.
branches.cn: 分散的努力被带进同一个节奏。

branches.en: Numbers on a grid name one exact place.
branches.cn: 网格上的数字命名一个确切的位置。

branches.en: Two items stand side by side without one bowing.
branches.cn: 两样东西并排而立，谁也不必低头。

branches.en: Both depend on things being set in relation to each other.
branches.cn: 两者都依赖事物之间的相互关系。

branches.en: A coordinate tells where, and to coordinate tells when and how.
branches.cn: 坐标说明在哪里，协调说明何时与如何。

intro.en: Coordinate is built on Latin co-, together, plus ordinare, to set in order.
intro.cn: coordinate 由拉丁语 co-（一起）与 ordinare（排列）构成。

latinIntro.en: The ordering base ordin- also appears in order, ordinary and subordinate.
latinIntro.cn: 排列词基 ordin- 也出现在 order、ordinary 与 subordinate 中。

items.meaning: to set parts in one order
items.meaningCN: 把各部分排进同一顺序

items.meaning: a person who arranges joint work

definition_zh: 有活力的；动态的；不断变化的；动力学的
definition_en: full of energy and force, constantly changing or active, relating to motion and forces, or describing an action rather than a state
core_image: 一股看不见的力推着齿轮转动，整个系统都在变
scene: 创业公司的会议室里，白板写满又擦掉，讨论一直没停。 She is a dynamic young manager who thrives on change.
sceneCN: 这里 dynamic 是「有活力的」（第 1 个义项：精力充沛、富有推动力）；句意是她是一位在变化中如鱼得水的有活力的年轻经理。

pos.zh: 形容词：有活力的；动态的；动力学的

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -s 构成，义为「动力学；动态；力度变化」
由本词加副词后缀 -ally 构成，义为「动态地；有活力地」
由希腊词根 dynam- 加 -ism 构成，义为「活力；推动力」

senses.title: Full of energy
senses.definition: full of energy, new ideas and forcefulness, especially of a person or style
senses.definitionCN: 充满精力、新想法与推动力，尤用于人或风格
senses.example: She is a dynamic young manager who thrives on change.
senses.exampleCN: 她是一位在变化中如鱼得水的有活力的年轻经理。
senses.why: Greek dynamis meant power, so a dynamic person is one who visibly carries power into whatever they do.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 dynamis 意为「力量」，所以 dynamic 的人就是明显把力量带进所做之事的人。

senses.title: Constantly changing
senses.definition: constantly changing, developing or moving, as a system, market or situation
senses.definitionCN: 不断变化、发展或运动，如系统、市场或局势
senses.example: The city has a dynamic economy that attracts young workers.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市拥有吸引年轻劳动者的充满活力的经济。
senses.why: A thing in motion cannot be captured in a single still picture, so dynamic marks whatever is still unfolding.
senses.whyCN: 运动中的事物无法被一张静止照片抓住，所以 dynamic 标记一切仍在展开的东西。

senses.title: Relating to forces in motion
senses.definition: relating to the forces that produce motion or change, used in physics and engineering
senses.definitionCN: 与产生运动或变化的力有关，用于物理与工程
senses.example: The engineers studied the dynamic loads on the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师研究了桥上的动态载荷。
senses.why: This is the technical home of the word: dynamis is power, and dynamics is the study of forces at work.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词的技术归宿：dynamis 是力量，dynamics 就是研究运作中的力。

senses.title: Describing action, in grammar
senses.definition: describing an action or event rather than a state, as a dynamic verb does
senses.definitionCN: 描述动作或事件而非状态，如动态动词
senses.example: In this grammar, run is a dynamic verb and own is a stative one.
senses.exampleCN: 在这套语法里，run 是动态动词，own 是状态动词。
senses.why: Grammar borrowed the word to separate verbs that move from verbs that merely hold a state.
senses.whyCN: 语法学借用了这个词，用来把表示动作的动词与仅仅表示状态的动词分开。

intro.en: Dynamic comes from Greek dynamis, power, through the adjective dynamikos and later Latin and French forms.
intro.cn: dynamic 来自希腊语 dynamis（力量），经由形容词 dynamikos 以及后来的拉丁语、法语形式进入英语。

items.en: Greek dynamis meant power, strength or capacity, and it could also mean a force in nature.
items.cn: 希腊语 dynamis 意为「力量、能力」，也可指自然中的一种力。

items.en: The adjective dynamikos meant powerful or relating to force, and it was used in philosophy and science.
items.cn: 形容词 dynamikos 意为「有力的、与力有关的」，用于哲学与科学。

items.en: Latin borrowed the Greek adjective as dynamicus, keeping its learned and scientific tone.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入这个希腊形容词作 dynamicus，保留了学术与科学的语气。

items.en: French dynamique carried the word into modern European languages, including English.
items.cn: 法语 dynamique 把这个词带入包括英语在内的现代欧洲语言。

items.en: English dynamic is recorded in the nineteenth century, first in physics and then in general description.
items.cn: 英语 dynamic 在十九世纪有记录，先用于物理，再用于一般描述。

items.en: The word now describes lively people, changing markets and moving forces, all from one idea of power.
items.cn: 这个词如今描述有活力的人、变化的市场与运动中的力，全部来自同一个「力量」观念。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same Greek power root; the near-meaning group separates energetic, active and vigorous by what kind of force they show.
note.cn: 形近组收同一希腊「力量」词根的词；近义组按所显现的力量类型区分 energetic、active 与 vigorous。

entries.definition: The study of forces and motion, or the pattern of forces in a situation.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「动力学、动态」，指对力与运动的研究，或局势中的力量格局。

entries.definition: Great energy, drive or forcefulness in a person or system.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「活力、推动力」，指人或系统中的巨大能量。

entries.definition: In a dynamic or energetic way; dynamic plus -ally.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「动态地、有活力地」，由 dynamic 加 -ally 构成。

entries.definition: An explosive; named from the same Greek word for power.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「炸药」，由同一个表示「力量」的希腊词命名。

entries.definition: Full of physical or mental energy; it stresses activity rather than force.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「精力充沛的」，强调活动而非力量。

entries.definition: Doing things, working or moving; neutral and broader than dynamic.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「活跃的、活动的」，中性且比 dynamic 更宽泛。

entries.definition: Strong, healthy and forceful in action; it stresses bodily strength.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「强健有力的」，强调身体力量。

entries.definition: Not moving or changing; the direct opposite of the changing sense of dynamic.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「静止的、静态的」，与 dynamic 的变化义正好相对。

normalIntro.en: These hooks go back to Greek dynamis, power, and follow it into people, markets, physics and grammar.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子回到希腊语 dynamis（力量），再跟着它走进人、市场、物理与语法。

normal.en: dynamis is power, so dynamic means carrying force.
normal.cn: dynamis 是力量，所以 dynamic 就是带着力量。

normal.en: A dynamic person moves things; a dynamic market keeps moving.
normal.cn: dynamic 的人能推动事情，dynamic 的市场一直在动。

normal.en: Dynamics is the science of those forces, and dynamism is the energy itself.
normal.cn: dynamics 是研究这些力的学问，dynamism 则是那股能量本身。

normal.en: Dynamic balance is balance kept while everything is moving.
normal.cn: dynamic balance 是在一切都在动的时候保持的平衡。

normal.en: A dynamic verb shows action, while a stative verb only holds a state.
normal.cn: 动态动词表示动作，状态动词只表示状态。

abstract.en: Picture a gear train turning with no visible hand behind it.
abstract.cn: 想象一组齿轮在转动，背后却看不见任何手。

abstract.en: The same force can be drawn as a person pushing a project, or as a line on a physics diagram.
abstract.cn: 同一股力可以画成一个人推动项目，也可以画成物理图上的一个箭头。

abstract.en: Dynamic is power that refuses to stay still.
abstract.cn: dynamic 是不肯停下来的力量。

examples.en: She is a dynamic young manager who thrives on change.
examples.cn: 她是一位在变化中如鱼得水的有活力的年轻经理。

examples.en: The city has a dynamic economy that attracts young workers.
examples.cn: 这座城市拥有吸引年轻劳动者的充满活力的经济。

examples.en: The engineers studied the dynamic loads on the bridge.
examples.cn: 工程师研究了桥上的动态载荷。

dict_mnemonic.text: dynam- 是「力量」：dynamic 就是身上带力、局面在动、物理里研究力的那个词。

root: 来自希腊语 dynamis「力量、能力」，经形容词 dynamikos 进入拉丁语 dynamicus，再经法语 dynamique 进入英语，十九世纪先用于物理学。同族词有 dynamics、dynamism、dynamite。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses of dynamic all carry one idea of power: in a person, in a changing system, in physical forces, and in verbs that show action.
sensesIntro.cn: dynamic 的四个义项都带着同一个「力量」观念：在人身上、在变化的系统中、在物理的力里，以及在表示动作的动词里。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gear train turning under an invisible force.
core.cn: 核心意象：一组齿轮在一股看不见的力下转动。

branches.en: THE PERSON: energy that visibly pushes other people and projects.
branches.cn: 人物线：明显能推动他人与项目的能量。

branches.en: THE SYSTEM: a market or city that keeps changing shape.
branches.cn: 系统线：不断改变形态的市场或城市。

branches.en: THE PHYSICS: forces that produce motion, measured and diagrammed.
branches.cn: 物理线：产生运动的力，被测量并画成图。

branches.en: THE VERB: grammar separates actions from states with the same word.
branches.cn: 动词线：语法用同一个词把动作与状态分开。

branches.en: ONE FORCE AT THREE SCALES: a person, a market and a machine all carry power in motion.
branches.cn: 同一股力的三种尺度：人、市场与机器都在运动中带着力量。

intro.en: Dynamic is a Greek-derived adjective; English adds -s, -ally and -ism to make its family.
intro.cn: dynamic 是源自希腊语的形容词；英语加 -s、-ally、-ism 构成词族。

latinIntro.en: Greek dynamis and dynamikos are recorded, and Latin dynamicus is attested as a learned borrowing.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 dynamis 与 dynamikos 均有记录，拉丁语 dynamicus 作为学术借词也有书证。
